column1: # What else a key can do besides opening an app ("Remote buttons", apps/core/lumen-remote keys package): the projector
# actions of the stock custom-key feature (X50, RS30, Titan: SystemUI RemoteCustomKeyUI, function list res/_i.json of
# SystemUI_release_838 / 848) that Lumen has. An action presses the Lumen key that already does it (an injected key:
# the model's own global-key route runs, so the action is the same as that key's on every model), or, for a function
# no key has, sends an intent to the projector app that a shared screen of it answers.
# Read by tools/remotes/gen_catalog.py into keys/KeyTable.java (ACTION_*). test/keys/check_keys.py checks that every
# framework overlay routes each key.
# Columns (tab separated, '-' = none):
#  id       stored as do:<id> for the key (never rename: a saved choice names it)
#  keycode  the key the action presses: never a key a user may give an app (keys.tsv), so a press cannot loop
#  intent   instead of a key: the intent action sent to the projector app itself (KeyActions.run: its activity if one
#           answers, else a broadcast), exactly one of keycode and intent
#  feature  shown only on a model whose device profile (devices/<c>/menu.json "features", in the app as
#           assets/lumen_menu/menu.json) has this feature: the per-model data of a function not every stock has
#  name     the text: lumen_remote_keys_do_<name>, <name>_<N> = with N as its argument
#  hdmi     shown only when the projector has at least this many HDMI inputs (TvInputManager), 0 = always
#  icon     its Lumen icon on the screen: res/drawable/lumen_ic_<icon> of apps/core/lumen-icons (Material Symbols,
#           tools/icons/icons.tsv), one per action, the HDMI actions share the HDMI port
#  stock    stock function codes it stands for (_i.json functionCode: title)
#  note     why
